# 2 Baruch Chapter 70 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 70:3 — great disorder formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "great-disorders, and-many-unrighteous deeds, and-much-apostasy" |
| LOGOS | "great disorders, and many unrighteous deeds, and much apostasy" |
| PNEUMA | "Great upheavals, many wicked acts, apostasy will be widespread" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac lists three abstract nouns in parallel; 'disorders' (Syriac: shgushya) is more precise than PNEUMA's 'upheavals' which shifts to physical catastrophe.

---

## 70:7 — messianic announcement

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-time-of-my-Messiah will-come" |
| LOGOS | "the time of my Messiah will come" |
| PNEUMA | "the time of my Messiah will arrive" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Come' (Syriac: neta) is the standard Syriac verb used throughout this text for the Messiah's arrival; 'arrive' is synonymous but LOGOS's consistency is preferable.

---
